<parameter name="content"># atlas

Monorepo with three services: `api/` (Go, gRPC), `web/` (React/TypeScript), `pipeline/` (Python, Airflow).
Service-specific rules live in `api/CLAUDE.md`, `web/CLAUDE.md`, `pipeline/CLAUDE.md`; they load when you work in that directory.

## Conventions
- Conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches off main, no long-lived branches.

## Other context
- Incident response: use the `incident-response` skill; do not improvise the runbook.
- Product metrics / live SQL: use the warehouse MCP server; do not hand-roll database clients.

<parameter name="content"># atlas context layout

| Location | Mechanism | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root) | CLAUDE.md | Org-wide conventions (commits, `make check`, trunk-based) apply everywhere, so they are always loaded; kept to a few lines. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | The `api/gen/` "generated by `make proto`, never hand-edit" rule only matters in Go work, so it loads only there. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | Warns that `npm test` launches real Playwright browsers and to use `npm run test:unit`; only relevant under `web/`. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | Notes that `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` must be set before DAGs import; only relevant under `pipeline/`. |
| `.claude/settings.json` PreToolUse hook (optional) | Hook | Deterministically blocks Edit/Write on `api/gen/**`; stronger than a prose warning against silent overwrites. |
| Incident-response runbook | Skill, distributed as a company plugin | A 20-step procedure is too long for always-loaded context and is identical across all teams, so a skill loads it on demand and a plugin ships one copy company-wide (single source of truth) instead of copies per repo. |
| Analytics warehouse access | MCP server (`.mcp.json` or analysts' user scope) | Live SQL is external data/tool connectivity; use a read-only credential, supplied via env vars and never committed. |

## Deliberately excluded
- The runbook steps and warehouse schemas are not in any CLAUDE.md; they would cost tokens every session for work most sessions never do.
- No per-service duplication of the org-wide conventions; the root file is the single source.
- Nothing Claude can derive from the code (directory structure, language idioms, standard build commands).

## Notes
- If only the atlas team uses the runbook, a repo-local `.claude/skills/incident-response/SKILL.md` works, but the plugin is preferable given company-wide usage.
- Give the skill a trigger-rich description (e.g. "incident, outage, page, sev, on-call, runbook") so it activates on varied phrasings.
- The Airflow requirement could be an env var in a hook or wrapper script later; a CLAUDE.md line is enough to start.
